zh: 保留下来的数组再删至多一个就严格递增，说明它去掉一个元素后是原数组的一个严格递增子序列；所以能保留多少个元素，取决于原数组最长严格递增子序列的长度 L。
保留的元素数最多是 L+1：先保留一个最长严格递增子序列，再任意加回一个没选的元素即可，删掉这个额外元素就递增；反过来保留更多一定会导致去掉一个后仍有长于 L 的递增子序列，矛盾。因此答案是 max(0, n−L−1)。
用经典的 O(n log n) 方法求严格 LIS：维护 tails 数组，tails[i] 为长度 i+1 的递增子序列的最小结尾；对每个数 x 用二分找第一个 ≥x 的位置（严格递增要用 lower_bound），替换或追加；最后输出 max(0, n−len(tails)−1)。
en: If the kept array becomes strictly increasing after deleting at most one more element, then without that element it is a strictly increasing subsequence of the original array. So how many elements you can keep depends on the length L of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.

At most L+1 elements can be kept: keep one longest strictly increasing subsequence and add back any one unused element; deleting that extra element leaves an increasing array. Keeping more would leave an increasing subsequence longer than L after one deletion, a contradiction. So the answer is max(0, n-L-1).

Compute the strict LIS in O(n log n): keep an array tails where tails[i] is the smallest tail of an increasing subsequence of length i+1. For each x, binary search the first position with a value >= x (lower_bound, because the order is strict) and replace it or append. Print max(0, n-len(tails)-1).

explanationEn:
## Approach

Find the length L of the longest strictly increasing subsequence; the answer is max(0,n-L-1).

## Proof of correctness

If m elements are kept and deleting at most one more makes them increasing, then the original array has an increasing subsequence of length at least m-1, so m<=L+1. Conversely, choose an LIS and add any one unchosen element; deleting that extra element gives an increasing array, which reaches min(n,L+1).

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
